name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Sweet Splash (I)
description:
Sweet, juicy, and easy on the pull. The Cheech & Chong Sweet Splash cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Sweet Splash brings a bright, fruit-forward profile: juicy mixed fruit and candy-sweet notes up front with a smooth, refreshing finish. Blended with an indica terpene profile for a relaxed, mellow feel — sweet and easygoing, made for kicking back and letting the day go.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Sweet Splash flavor — juicy mixed fruit with a sweet, refreshing finish
Indica terpene blend — relaxing and mellow, ideal for evenings
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Sweet flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Sweet Splash is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
